response.text:
I can do that — but deleting emails is a destructive action, so I need a couple quick confirmations first.

1) Target: I plan to target messages from the Atlassian domain in the 2023 calendar year using this Gmail search:
   from:(@atlassian.com) after:2022/12/31 before:2024/01/01
   - Is that the correct scope? (If Atlassian notifications may come from other addresses, tell me specific senders or other criteria to include, e.g. subject contains "Jira" or "Bitbucket".)

2) Action (choose one):
   - Archive (removes from Inbox but keeps them in All Mail) — reversible.
   - Move to Trash (removed from Inbox; auto-permanently deleted after 30 days).
   - Permanently delete now (irreversible).
   Which do you want?

3) Preview option: do you want me to show subject/date of the first 5 matching threads before I act?

Reply with:
- Confirmed search (or edits), and
- Which action to take (archive / trash / permanent delete), and
- Whether you want a 5-item preview.

Once you confirm, I will proceed and report how many messages I changed.
